messages.subject: proof of enrollment
parts:
Stephanie Taylor from Google just said the following on the GSoC-
mentors list.

"If the student doesn't submit their proof of enrollment by the
deadline in just over an hour then they are not eligible to participate
in GSoC (which is why the Final draft shared isn't being displayed in
your dashboard)."

So, at least preliminary proof of enrollment must be submitted before
the deadline, and likely accounts for several of the student
applications I stilkl see as Draft on the R GSoC Dashboard.

Regards,

Brian
